question: What is the earliest possible week for ovulation to resume after an abortion?
explanation: Ovulation can occur as early as two weeks post-abortion, meaning fertility returns long before the first normal period. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h1)

question: Why must nurses provide contraceptive counseling before a patient is discharged after an abortion?

options.A: Fertility returns quickly before the next menstrual period
options.B: Patients completely forget all pre-procedure instructions
options.C: Hormonal pills take six weeks to build up efficacy
options.D: Hospital policy mandates filling prescriptions on site

explanation: Because ovulation can happen within a fortnight, patients are at immediate risk of unintended pregnancy without early contraceptive initiation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h1)

question: Client-centered contraceptive counseling primarily focuses on which patient aspect?

options.D: Personal lifestyle and reproductive life plans

explanation: Counseling centers on the individual's unique preferences, daily habits, and future family goals rather than a generalized approach. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h2)

question: A nurse counseling a patient post-abortion should prioritize what action?

options.A: Delaying the discussion until the six-week follow-up visit
options.B: Choosing the cheapest available barrier method automatically
options.C: Assessing medical eligibility without imposing personal biases
options.D: Insisting on permanent surgical sterilization methods

explanation: Unbiased guidance combined with safe medical screening ensures the patient chooses an appropriate, effective method safely. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h2)

question: What defines immediate post-abortion contraception?

options.A: Inserting an IUD at the annual routine checkup
options.B: Beginning hormones six weeks after the procedure
options.C: Waiting until the first normal menstrual period
options.D: Starting the method before leaving the facility

explanation: Immediate initiation happens on the exact day of the abortion procedure before the client is discharged home. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h3)

question: The main advantage of immediate contraceptive initiation over interval initiation is what?

options.A: Lower cost of manufacturing intrauterine contraceptive devices
options.B: Higher likelihood the patient actually receives protection
options.C: Complete prevention of future pelvic inflammatory disease
options.D: Total elimination of all potential hormonal side effects

explanation: Providing methods on the spot overcomes the barrier of patients failing to return for their scheduled interval appointments. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h3)

question: Which items are classified as long-acting reversible contraceptives?

options.A: Male condoms and diaphragm barrier caps
options.D: Combined oral pills and injectable depots

explanation: LARC methods consist of intrauterine devices and contraceptive implants that provide continuous protection for several years. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h4)

question: Why are LARC methods highly effective for post-abortion care?

options.A: They do not require daily compliance from the user
options.B: They permanently stop all future ovarian hormone production
options.C: They protect against all known sexually transmitted infections
options.D: They completely eliminate any risk of abnormal uterine bleeding

explanation: Because LARCs work passively once placed, user error or missed daily doses are completely removed as failure factors. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h4)

question: A key dual benefit of barrier methods like condoms is what?

options.A: Preventing pregnancy and sexually transmitted infections
options.B: Eliminating all localized pelvic cramps instantly
options.C: Regulating heavy menstrual cycles without daily pills
options.D: Providing continuous protection for up to five years

explanation: Condoms are unique because they block both conception and transmission of pathogens during intercourse. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h5)

question: What is a major drawback of short-acting hormonal pills compared to LARC methods?

options.A: They require strict daily adherence to maintain effectiveness
options.B: They always cause permanent irreversible infertility over time
options.C: They interfere directly with the action of routine antibiotics
options.D: They cannot be prescribed immediately after an abortion procedure

explanation: Pills rely heavily on the patient remembering to take them at the same time every day to prevent ovulation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h5)

question: How should a nurse handle a patient's fear that an IUD causes permanent infertility?

options.A: Advise the patient to avoid all modern contraception
options.B: Force the patient to accept the IUD despite their fear
options.C: Provide evidence-based education debunking the myth
options.D: Agree that fertility is permanently damaged by devices

explanation: Calm, accurate explanation helps relieve anxiety and allows patients to make informed choices without fear. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h6)

question: A patient refuses contraception due to community rumors about weight gain. What is the best nursing response?

options.A: Refuse to discharge the patient until a method is forced on them
options.B: Ignore the comment and document that the patient is non-compliant
options.C: Tell the patient that community rumors are always completely true
options.D: Acknowledge the concern and discuss realistic side effect profiles

explanation: Validating patient concerns while offering factual guidance builds trust and encourages adherence. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h6)

question: What is a vital component of post-abortion contraceptive documentation?

options.A: The serial numbers of all general ward linen used
options.B: The personal religious beliefs of the attending physician
options.C: The specific contraceptive method chosen by the patient
options.D: The exact financial cost of the hospital procedure

explanation: Recording the agreed-upon method ensures continuity of care across different healthcare providers. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h7)

question: Why is scheduling a follow-up visit important after post-abortion contraceptive initiation?

options.A: To collect mandatory administrative penalty fees from clients
options.B: To check method satisfaction and assess any side effects
options.C: To perform a second surgical evacuation procedure routinely
options.D: To renew nursing license credentials for the clinic staff

explanation: Follow-up visits give nurses an opportunity to troubleshoot issues, manage side effects, and confirm the method is working out. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T015#GNS226_U5_T015_h7)
